verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover all three deployment modes in the story. Pandoc ships a Haskell library alongside the CLI, an official pandoc/latex container image, and an HTTP server mode (pandoc-server). It can also be compiled as a fully self-contained binary for running in your own environment, including CI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of running the server or container modes, and detailed documentation of the server-mode API beyond the build-flag mention.
